success_criterion: task-specific: Faucet rotated by around 90 degrees; Bucket lifted to a given height; Laptop lid angle changed; Toilet lid opened past a threshold degree (exact numeric thresholds not stated in the paper text)
headline_metric: success rate (mean +/- std over 3 seeds), seen/unseen objects
paper_code_mismatch: Paper describes the reward as an indicator-based reach term, a contact term requiring palm+2 fingers touching, a part-manipulation progress term, and an action-penalty term ('more details in supplementary material', not on disk); the actual code implements a 3-stage state-machine reward with an early-done time bonus, a controller-error penalty, and (for Bucket) explicit forbidden-base-contact and lift-rate terms not described in the paper text.
note_gaps: Success-rate numeric thresholds (rotation degrees, lift height, lid angle) are stated qualitatively in the paper but the exact numbers live in un-extracted code (is_done); physics settings (timestep, substeps, friction) are not reported anywhere in either source.
